firstPlayerRule: Randomly arrange the play-order markers on the play-order track for the first round. The player in space 1 goes first.
clarifications: Place the Federation markers in the opposite order during setup. Follow the play-order track for the entire first round; later rounds use the Federation system to determine a new order.
